name.la: Judicium de libro quem Lutherani vocant Concordiae
name.en-US: Judgment on the Lutheran Book of Concord
name.pt-BR: Juízo sobre o Livro da Concórdia luterano

description.la: Judicium de libro quem Lutherani vocant Concordiae (1585). Textus ex editione Vivès (1870-74), tomo VII, ex scanno OCR.
description.en-US: Bellarmine's judgment on the Lutheran Book of Concord (1585). Latin only: the Vivès edition (1870-74), volume 7, from an OCR scan.
description.pt-BR: Juízo de Belarmino sobre o Livro da Concórdia luterano (1585).

sources.edition: Roberti Bellarmini Opera omnia, ed. Justin Fèvre, tom. 7 (Paris: Vivès, 1870-74).
sources.description: Archive.org OCR (djvu.txt, Boston College copy) cleaned by script: running heads, page numbers and the reference-only footnote blocks removed, line-end hyphens joined, recognisable OCR slips corrected by a lexicon pass, so some remain.
sources.tierEvidence: Bellarmine died in 1621; the Vivès edition of 1870-74 is public domain.
